test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct option is** 'in'.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **preposition** is a word or group of words used before a noun, pronoun or noun phrase to show direction, time, place or relation to an object.

 
 
• **Example: "to", "with", "on", "in" etc.**
 
 
 
• ​The preposition **'in'** is used to express the situation of something that is or appears to be enclosed or surrounded by something else.
 
 
• Example: ***In attempting***__ *__to save the child from falling, he almost lost his life.__*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, preposition **'in'** will be used here.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Let's discuss about the remaining prepositions -

__
 
• **To -** It is used to express the motion in the direction of something.

 
 
• **Example:** I am going **to** gym.__*
 
 
 
• **With -** It is used to express togetherness or accompanied by someone or something,
 __
 
• Example: *He will go to coaching classes **with **his friend.*__
 
 
 
• **On - **It is used to express the position of something above something else.
 __
 
• Example: *I kept my keys **on **the table.*__
 
 

***So the correct passage would be-****The Defence Minister complimented the IAF for its rapid deployment of assets at forward locations **(1) in** response to the border row with China in eastern Ladakh. The current combat readiness has sent a strong message to our (2) _________, he said. In an address to the top commanders of (3) _________ IAF on the opening day of a three-day conference, the defence minister said the nations resolve to defend its sovereignty (4) _________ firm and that the people of the country have full confidence in the (5) _________ of its armed forces.*

5c
